llm_response.reason: The website lacks accessible privacy and contact pages (both return 404 errors), which means there is no visible business or customer support information—a clear violation of e-commerce standards. SSL security issues were detected, further indicating poor site security. The shop purports to sell products from the real brand 'Des Petits Hauts' but provides no verifiable proof of legitimacy or authorization, strongly suggesting possible brand impersonation. These factors together are classic attributes of fake online shopping scams.
